blocks.text: STA. BARBARA, Pangasinan — A five-year-old boy died from drowning in a fishpond at a farm in Barangay Gueguesangen in the Pangasinan town of Santa Barbara on Sunday evening. Police said the victim was brought to the Region I Medical Center in Dagupan City after he was retrieved from the fishpond. But the attending physician declared the boy dead on arrival. The victim’s 31-year-old aunt, Kris Aquino Desear, 31, said she had just bathed the child at around 5:10 p.m. and left him near a fishpond outside the bathroom while she took a bath and changed clothes.
